scoring_justification: The absolute ΔG values are method-dependent; the robust verifiable claim is the relative ordering and positivity. A full recompute of exact values from raw DFT outputs would require an identical functional/basis and is infeasible without controlling the solver's exact setup.

hidden_assets.purpose: Logical check: ΔG(Py-CITP-BT-COF) < ΔG(Py-FTP-BT-COF) < ΔG(Py-HTP-BT-COF) and all > 0
hidden_assets.source_provenance: derived from paper's statement that the energy barrier for H* formation on site 4 is reduced by 0.83 eV for Cl and 0.15 eV for F relative to H, implying Cl < F < H and all endothermic
hidden_assets.generation_method: Enforced in checker logic; no numeric gold table is stored.
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: The ordering is the explicit structural claim of the paper, not a fabricated test set.

outputs.description: Gibbs free energy changes for H* adsorption on the halogenated BT unit site 4, in eV, for the three COF variants.

schema.description: Concatenated XYZ files; each molecular geometry preceded by a comment line '# Py-XTP-BT-COF' with X=H,F,Cl.

outputs.description: Optimized Cartesian coordinates of the three fragment+H* complexes.

output_contract.notes: The primary scored target is the relative ordering of ΔG values: ΔG(Py-CITP-BT-COF) < ΔG(Py-FTP-BT-COF) < ΔG(Py-HTP-BT-COF) and all must be positive. The optimized structures are checked for existence and basic format.

steps.description: Verify that all three ΔG values are positive and that ΔG(Cl) < ΔG(F) < ΔG(H).
Check that the XYZ file contains three properly formatted molecular geometry blocks with expected comment headers.
